name: popover
title: Popover
description: Token-driven floating panel. Portaled to document.body; outside-click + escape dismiss; arrow key navigation.

rules: Radix manages role + aria-haspopup + escape-to-close + outside-click dismiss.
Outside-click dismiss exempts the portaled list itself (don't double-dismiss).
Focus moves into Popover on open; returns to trigger on close.
